info.name: sunset-orchestrator Postman Collection
info.description:
API deprecation lifecycle orchestration for the ForgeSphere platform.
Manages the graceful retirement of old API versions, SDKs, and endpoints 
across all consumers. Automates the deprecation timeline — announce, 
measure usage, warn consumers, track migration, and finally sunset — 
with zero unexpected breakage. Provides legal-grade evidence that 
deprecation was fair and announced. Integrates with Contract Chronicle, 
Notifier, and Compliance Vault.


OpenAPI version: 1.0.0

variable.description: Override with the base URL of the deployed Apigee proxy.

request.description:
Announce a new API deprecation

Responses:
- 201: Deprecation announced and lifecycle started.
- 400: Invalid payload, missing fields, or invalid dates.
- 409: This version is already deprecated or sunset.
- 500: Traffic telemetry or notification engine unavailable.
